purpose: Check whether representative rejected source trials were blocked by actual instruction changes or comparison identity errors. Read-only; no trial repeated.

palette_trial.finding: Two representative losses are real emitted-code differences.
palette_trial.provenance: Preserved unrouted trial image and PDB. Exact decorated C2D symbols and extents agree with saved trial COFF route fingerprints. Masked image bytes hash to those fingerprints; relocation symbol names are excluded from the fingerprint.

on_size.difference: Trial adds EBX save/restore; WORD scheduling and divisor register differ. These differences do not depend on renamed call targets.

palette_trial.limits: Unrouted call addresses differ from final routed report. Old PDB and current source produce unrelated annotation warnings; exact symbols and fingerprint equality establish these two bodies. Does not prove identity or semantics of all 39 changed rows.

default_constructor_trial.evidence_available: Nineteen header paths and 306 score-delta rows. Original C2D::OnSize identity and extent corroborated by baseline reports and Windows/Mac catalogs.
default_constructor_trial.evidence_missing: No rejected image/PDB, rebuilt address or instruction diff located in the searched main and relevant audit build snapshots.
default_constructor_trial.limit: Cannot independently distinguish code generation from a mapping error for this trial using located summaries. Historical thunk verification constrains identity but is not instruction-level proof. No repetition of the rejected source family justified solely by missing artifacts.

comparison_path.finding: No concrete comparison defect identified. Local Compare preserves upstream matching and installs symmetric assembly parsers; both sides use the matched entity's common name.
comparison_path.limits: Catalog validates class/method identity but omits signatures and collapses destructor variants. Upstream matching may select the first duplicate full/demangled name with a warning. Saved-thunk verification covers manifest routes, not every overload or duplicate body. Passing these checks does not universally exclude mapping drift.
comparison_path.decision: Do not change normalizers, symbol overrides or scores to conceal demonstrated instruction changes.

remaining: All nine categories remain open. This review strengthens rejection evidence; it supplies no supported source correction. Existing clean hypotheses still regress required matching, and no supported untried structural route was identified. Original declaration/inline context or new binary evidence remains necessary to reopen those families.
